usage: Use CanvasToolbar to enhance your user interface. This component provides a consistent, accessible, and well-designed solution for this use case.
CanvasToolbar integrates seamlessly with other components in the design system. Follow the established patterns and guidelines to ensure consistency across your application.

props.name: blueprints
props.description: Blueprints available for selection in the left section.

props.name: searchableBlueprints
props.description: Render the blueprint picker as a searchable Combobox instead of a Select.

props.name: blueprintSearchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder shown inside the searchable picker's input.

props.name: blueprintTriggerWidth
props.description: Trigger width for the blueprint picker.

props.name: blueprintTailChars
props.description: Number of trailing characters always kept visible in middle truncation.

props.name: pageIndex
props.description: 1-based current page index. When omitted (or pageCount <= 1) the pager is hidden.

props.name: pageCount
props.description: Total number of pages in the active blueprint.

props.name: drawingActions
props.description: Drawing tools props. Pass `null` to hide the middle section.

props.name: zoomTools
props.description: Zoom tools props. Pass `null` to hide the right section.

bestPractices.title: Use semantic props
bestPractices.description: Use the component's built-in props rather than className overrides.

bestPractices.title: Don't override core styles
bestPractices.description: Avoid using className to override the component's fundamental styling.

bestPractices.title: Provide accessible labels
bestPractices.description: Include proper ARIA labels for screen reader users.

bestPractices.title: Don't skip accessibility
bestPractices.description: Never omit accessibility attributes for interactive components.

bestPractices.title: Handle all states
bestPractices.description: Account for loading, error, empty, and success states.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore edge cases
bestPractices.description: Avoid showing broken UI when data is missing or loading.
